source.scope: Connected original event wrapper 0x4a4b60 with real decision, orientation, bounds copy and rider event selection callees. Root bike target; source root or child; three ordered child records over two components (siblings or parent/child), both real callback branches with repeated component updates; supplied input-query result, valid rider records and CRT draws with call counts checked. Positive collision speeds, finite nondegenerate axes. Arbitrary graph aliases, parented bike targets, live rider data, RNG/input subsystem and whole-bike trajectories excluded.
